fieldValues.title: The programme repository's full chain
fieldValues.summary: Demonstrates the whole chain on the programme repository: the Blueprint prompt renders the Protocol, compositions project the programme overview, and srs tree walks the concept tree. If the pattern cannot carry a four-phase programme it will not carry a 433-record specification.
